newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended little changed at 8.2933 on Friday against the U.S. dollar, setting a new 11-week high one point up from Thursday's 8.2934 with trading interest waning ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2934.
Pro-yuan sentiment is still strong, but investors are waiting for a clear indication of the central bank's position after the successive gains of the past few sessions.
